main_text.l: Athenæo, Philosophiæ Professoris Ordinarij, Domini Præceptoris sui omni observantiâ colendi.
Subjicit ac pro viribus tuendam suscipit,
JOH. RODOLPHUS SALCHLINUS, Zoph. Philosophiæ Studiosus.
Ad diem 10. Augusti, loco horisq; solitis.
Excudebat ILLUSTRISSIMÆ REIPUBLICÆ BERNENSIS TYPOGRAPHUS, Georgius Sonnleitnerus.

page.notes: Printer's ornament (woodcut fleuron) between the Ad diem line and the imprint, not transcribed. The Greek "Σὺν θεῷ" and "Συζητήσει" are as printed; the second Greek word is set in a italic form and may differ slightly from standard spelling. The "Ad diem 10." line has the long-s and italic ligature forms modernised to plain s only where a long s appeared.
